name: Ballada o Krovi, Tumane i Mgle
original_name: Баллада о Крови, Тумане и Мгле
source:
Fantastic story set in medieval Germany with characters suspiciously similar to Kathrin and Maxim. Only similar? And who on earth is the girl in the mask…?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620960/Young_Hearts_Ballada_o_Krovi_Tumane_i_Mgle/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一則發生在中世紀德國的奇幻故事，裡面的人物和卡特琳與馬克西姆相似得可疑。真的只是相似嗎？那個戴面具的姑娘又究竟是誰……？

［取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620960/Young_Hearts_Ballada_o_Krovi_Tumane_i_Mgle/]Steam[/url]］
